implemented: Preserve empty/offscreen masks across CPU, browser GPU and native GPU; shared mask selection and zero-alpha picking.
Rust atomic versioned patches, transaction preview/commit/cancel, inverse-patch undo/redo with 80-step and 64 MiB bounds; sparse frontend updates and worker patch transport.
IndexedDB per-document UUID records, legacy migration, catalog/trash/restore, CAS saves, durable unknown-result outbox and safe document switching.

Shared Rust text shaping/layout, uploaded TTF/OTF, fallback selection, wrapping, weight/line metrics/tracking/alignment/direction and grapheme-safe UTF-16 style ranges; textarea composition lifecycle.
Worker recreation after timeout/failure, full document reload after reset, stale callback isolation.
Active-edge sampled raster sweep with unchanged sample/intersection/rounding model; frozen legacy differential oracle.
Local-plane gradient compilation, shared dash phase including dashOffset, explicit unsupported SVG effects rejection and corrected export bounds.
Shared Q24 fractional tent coefficients plus bounded CPU prefix-sum rounding refinement and byte-domain shadow composition; preserves old mathematical tent oracle separately.
File schema 2, explicit render profile with standard default after measured fine-mode memory regression; old schema readable.
Independent CI and current architecture/development docs; acceptance UI separates threshold gates from raw byte differences.

primary_references.application: Boundary-integral reasoning and filter validation; not a full implementation of arbitrary overlapping analytic curves.
Local coordinate representation for gradient coefficients; not a full cell-stream renderer.
Distinguish local inverse history from collaborative undo.

rejected_proposals: Offscreen alpha mask must not expose nonintersecting content: actual Figma PNG exports show red content disappears.
Standard BTreeMap clone is O(N), not O(log N) persistent snapshot.
Signed area summation then clamp is not a complete nonzero/even-odd solution for overlapping contours.
SIMD, parallel tiles, general curve Boolean and ICC changes require a specific measured target and separate acceptance; not implemented by checklist.
